reviews.title: Realidad
reviews.text: Es buena, pero en los precios siento que están súper valorados. Te cobran aparte de cada cosa que te recomiendan. Muy bonito todo lo que dice, pero siento que es más para tenerte enganchado y seguir gastando, aparte que también te cobran mensual la aplicación. En un solo día se me fueron $50 solo por una conversación que era gratis 3 minutos y como se pasó se cobraron más, aparte que contestan bien atrasados en tiempo y eso aún así lo cobran, no son muy claros con la respuesta pero en algunas te termina agradando
reviews.reply:
Hi there, 

Thank you for being so open about your experience. I’m sorry to hear that parts of it felt overwhelming or not as clear as expected, especially regarding pricing and chat timing. It’s good to hear there were still aspects you found valuable, but I understand that doesn’t balance out the frustration. 

Please reach out to support-appstore@asknebula.com, and we’ll personally review your case and help you make sense of everything.

Holding space for your journey,
Nebula

reviews.title: Bad Interfaz
reviews.text: I don’t understand why you guys change the page interface. I used to love my astral chart. Bad decision that’s leads to delete the app.
reviews.reply:
Hello dear [Name],  
  
Thank you for sharing your feedback with us. We’re really sorry to hear that the changes to the interface have caused you frustration. We understand how important the astral chart is, and we appreciate your past support.  
 
Your input is valuable, and we’ll make sure to pass your comments on to our development team as we continue to improve the app. If there’s anything else we can do to assist you or if you’d like to share more thoughts, please don’t hesitate to reach out to us at nebula.support@nebulahoroscope.com.  
 
Have a great day 💜️

reviews.title: Charged After Unsubscribing
reviews.text: I tried the app for 2 days and then I unsubscribed and deleted it. But 3 days later, they charged my card. I have written to them, but they do not respond
reviews.reply:
Hello, dear user. Thank you for your feedback. 

We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience you experienced and appreciate your patience. Your satisfaction is our priority and we are actively working to resolve your billing issue.

You can also rest assured that your request is a high priority for our support team. To speed up the resolution of this situation, please contact us again via this email nebula.support@nebulahoroscope.com.

Thank you for bringing this to our attention, and we appreciate your understanding.

Best regards, Nebula team.

reviews.title: They always find away to charge u .
reviews.text: They always find away to charge u .
reviews.reply: Hello! We have a big team of astrologers and developers working on this app daily, and their work has to be paid. That is why Nebula has a paid subscription option. However, our app also offers a lot of completely free highly-personalized content that you can easily access without a subscription.
